create_DINOHead: create a DINOHead module with configurable MLP layers and weight-normalized last layer for self-supervised learning
build_DINOHead_mlp: build a DINOHead with batch normalization and GELU activations in the MLP predictor head
run_DINOHead_forward: run the DINOHead forward pass to project normalized features to output dimension
build_MLP_with_build_mlp: build an MLP with configurable layers, hidden dimensions, and optional batch normalization using _build_mlp
review_DINOHead_init_weights: review the DINOHead weight initialization using truncated normal distribution with std 0.02
